profile.headline: Full-Stack Dev
profile.summary:
I’m a Full Stack Developer with many years of experience building scalable, user-centric web applications from the ground up. I enjoy working across the MEAN stack—but I promise I am very kind.

Over the years, I’ve collaborated closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to turn complex requirements into reliable, high-quality systems. I care deeply about clean code, performance, and maintainability, and I’m always looking for ways to improve systems rather than just ship features.

My experience spans modern frameworks, backend services, databases, and cloud-based deployments. I’m comfortable owning features end-to-end and thrive in environments where problem-solving, learning, and impact matter.

Outside of day-to-day development, I enjoy running, art and video games.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Owned full-stack development for a customer service application using MEAN stack, powering call centers for a major telecom company and supporting 7,000+ agents and 1M+ customer interactions.
- Engineered call center KPI dashboards for executives using Angular and MongoDB, surfacing 25+ metrics enabling a 12% improvement in agent throughput and faster issue resolution.
- Led the development of a Learning Management System (LMS), standardizing the onboarding experience for all incoming hires across our client's company of 4000+ employees annually.
- Implemented features enabling data-driven analysis of agent strengths and weaknesses, providing managers with actionable insights that enhanced the effectiveness of new hire training and provided clear metrics for performance evaluation post-onboarding.
- Designed & created multiple unified knowledge base platforms, consolidating troubleshooting guides and procedures to significantly improve agent overall support consistency.
- Developed an Error Tool application to optimize workflow for agents at call centers with about 80,000 errors processed each month and increased productivity by over 200%.
- Mentored 2 junior engineers, conducted code reviews, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

company.name: Parsons School of Design - The New School

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching assistant for the class called Creativity and Computation Lab. Mainly helping students in Arduino, JavaScript, Unity and OpenFrameworks. I am also a teaching assistant for the Undergraduate Design and Technology program as part of the DT Study Program helping and tutoring in both design concepts and coding problems.

positions.title: Bootcamp Teaching Fellow
positions.description: Taught a three week intensive coding course for incoming MFA DT students entering the program. The course focused on the fundamentals of coding and interactive digital art utilizing Processing as the primary coding language.
